minimize_FX_graph: minimize a failing FX GraphModule by removing suffix nodes and delta debugging to find the minimal failing graph
propagate_concrete_values: propagate concrete tensor values through an FX graph using ConcreteProp interpreter to annotate node metadata
check_nvfuser_subprocess: check if an FX module fails under nvfuser by running it in a subprocess with fallback disabled
check_nvfuser_correctness_subprocess: check nvfuser correctness by comparing fused vs reference outputs in a subprocess with tolerance threshold
convert_node_to_placeholder: convert an FX graph node to a placeholder input using its concrete value for delta debugging
